training_config.selector: Per-policy learned bilinear f(condition)^T W_k g(candidate), plus learned candidate-specific preservation/consequence scalar terms and bias
training_config.initialization: Exact V4 condition encoder, candidate generator, preservation and consequence modules; new selector initialized with seed 42
training_config.target: Per-image equal-weight average normalized ranks over fidelity L1, preservation distortion, consequence error; softmax(-mean_rank/0.25), no quotas or resampling
training_config.preprocessing: paired RGB ToTensor [0,1]; paired random horizontal flip train only

diagnosis.freeze_recommendation: Use V4 as the strongest enhancement baseline for paper purposes; retain this final-selector checkpoint as a negative/partial adaptive-selection investigation. No further architecture experiment. Final held-out evaluation not run.
diagnosis.decision_reason: The selector still collapses in actual argmax choices: Aggressive is selected for 366/370 validation images; Conservative and Balanced are each selected twice. Counts stay nearly constant across severity quartiles. Mean probabilities and entropy are less collapsed than V7, but the required hard input-specific variation is not demonstrated at a meaningful frequency.
diagnosis.quality_note: Validation PSNR/SSIM are close to V4 but slightly lower; this small quality change does not compensate for near-total Aggressive selection collapse.
